Label: Title
HelpText: The title that you want to appear in the Library or that appears on the input prompt in the ERP or other software

Label: Table Name
HelpText: The target filename for the ERP or other software

Label: Purpose
HelpText: Any information you want to record about the table

Label: Maximum ERP Description Field Length
HelpText: The maximum description length that is permitted by the software for this particular table

Label: Number of Code Columns
HelpText: Your best estimate of the number of columns required for the table, you can add and remove tables in the worksheet

Label: Pad codes with trailing
HelpText: The padding character defaults to period (fullstop) but can be changed to 0 -- 0 is NOT recommended

Label: Delimit codes with
HelpText: Code delimiter defaults to dash (-) but offers other options for aesthetic reasons and software constraints

Label: Code Delimiters
HelpText: Specify the location of delimiters, default is after every three code characters which is optimum for human interpretation and anotation

Label: Replace leading space with other ASCII character?
HelpText: Descriptions are padded with spaces or the character you enter here, many software systems will strip leading spaces in which case underscore (_) is the next best choice

Label: Leading Pad Character
HelpText: This is the delimiter on Concatenated Exports

Label: Description Suffixes required (0 to 6)
HelpText: The number of suffix fields on the table, in most cases this would be one field but in the case of complex Charts of Accounts may be more

Label: Suffix Width
HelpText: The number of characters, this is per suffx, typically 3 or 4 characters is recommened

Label: Delimiter before this suffix
HelpText: The delimiter before each suffix, typically a dash (-)

Label: Constant or Editable
HelpText: In many cases, particulary a block for a component of coding in the Chart of Accounts the suffix might be constant for a table, in other cases, it may be a unique text string to add intelligence about the hiearchy to the table entries

Label: Constant Value
HelpText: Where the Suffix is constant, the text to be entered

Label: Code Cell Right-Click Menu
HelpText: The Code menu provides a wide range of functionality to manipulate the codes -- Note that in preparing a taxonomy the procedure is first to build the description hierarchy to a point where it full describes the subject of the taxonomy and only then build the codes -- it may take several iterations to get the codes to the right stanard

Label: Description Cell Right-Click Menu
HelpText: The Description menu provies a wide range of functionality to manipulate the descriptions -- Note that in preparing a taxonomy the procesure is first to build the description hierarchy and only then build the codes -- the descriptions should be indented with no more than nine rows in any segment of the hieararchy based on Millers Law which states that the average human being can quickly grasp seven plus or minus two items of information so limiting the descriptions to a maximum of nine at any level makes the codes easy to read and action -- if  you find you are going over nine then step back and see if there are two levels present and if you come in under five then review and see whether you can regroup somehow

Label: Suffix Cell Right-Click Menu
HelpText: The Suffixes are for classification information to make long lists easier to interpret -- Suffixes can be fixed within a table or segments of a table or can be variable and unique to distinguish different elements of the code scheme

Label: Worksheet Guidance
HelpText: The Worksheet is designed to help users quickly and accurately build a Precision Taxonomy, look at the help on the Code and Description right click menus for more guidance
